title: Collectors
objectives: Collect a stream into a list, a set, a String or a map with collect and Collectors.
Group and split with groupingBy and partitioningBy, and flatten nested lists with flatMap.

readings.title: Using a Collector as a Terminal Operation
readings.lookFor: The sections "Collecting in a String of Characters", "Partitioning Elements with a Predicate" and "Collecting in a Map with Grouping By". You can stop before the post-processing sections.
